page.notes: No marginal notes or reference marks are printed. The small marks at the right edge are specks and stains, not text. The catchword "for-" and the signature "t" at the foot are doubtful: the "t" sits to the left of the catchword and may be a gathering mark. "nerali" (line beginning "neralí formula") is uncertain; the scan is faint there, so the word is marked [?]. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. Lowercase u and v are normalised to vowel u and consonant v, and capital V-forms likewise (e.g. SVVS, FILIVS, QVI).
